LanguageData.SSF_Menu_ChooseDesc: Select a form to shapeshift into.
LanguageData.SSF_Message_NoProjectile: This attack cannot be used because it has no projectile.
LanguageData.SSF_Message_CannotDropGeneratedWeapon: Cannot drop form-specific weapons while transformed.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_MaxGizmo_Desc: If the number of forms exceeds this value, they will be collapsed into a dropdown menu.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_PortraitScale_Desc: Applies each form's portraitDrawScale to the info-card portrait. Turn this OFF if it conflicts with UI mods that alter portraits.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_WeaponScale_Desc: Scales held weapons uniformly based on the shapeshift body draw scale. Turn this OFF if another mod already scales weapons.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_ReequipInventory_Desc: After reverting, the pawn will automatically reequip weapons and tools stored in their inventory.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_ReequipGround_Desc: After reverting, the pawn will automatically pick up and reequip previously dropped gear nearby.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_ForbidItems_Desc: Temporarily marks items dropped during the transformation process as forbidden.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_VerbToggle_Desc: Displays an auto-attack toggle directly on the attack command gizmo.
LanguageData.SSF_Setting_DebugLog_Desc: Prints detailed internal framework operations to the RimWorld debug log. Only enable this for mod development or bug reporting.
LanguageData.SSF_GizmoDisabled_AlreadyTransformed: Already transformed into {0}. Cannot shift to another form.
LanguageData.SSF_GizmoDisabled_RaceNotAllowed: This form is not available for {0}.
